answer.reason: Based on the scale of Hawaii's QCEW-covered employment, NAICS 54 (Professional, scientific, and technical services) is one of Hawaii's larger private sectors, typically in the high-30,000s to ~40,000 covered jobs range in recent years. A December 2024 level of about 39,063 fits that pattern, whereas 26,691 is more consistent with a smaller sector (e.g., finance and insurance, NAICS 52) than with professional/scientific/technical services. Therefore B is the supported choice for the NAICS 54 December 2024 private employment level.

B. 39,063 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Hawaii statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/15000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: B
